boolean_eggs.name: Boolean Eggs — a darkness held
boolean_eggs.description: Three deep-colour CSG ovoids on a colliding low plinth: union, intersection and a genuinely concave subtraction whose interior material removes lighting cues.
boolean_eggs.reference_artist: Anish Kapoor (original response, not a reconstruction)
interactions: Walk around the three forms; compare the lit rim with the unlit cavity.
boolean_eggs.qfep_connection: The deterministic cut makes a boundary; its material decides which depth cues remain visible.
boolean_eggs.status: Installed in Boolean_Works; desktop capture verified separately from headset acceptance.

conical_sightline.name: One cut, three rooms
conical_sightline.description: Three walls receive one conical cutter; a witness display retains the intersections. An original study after Conical Intersect, not a reconstruction.

parameters.cut_x: Shared cutter X offset, -0.65 to 0.85 metres; set_cut_x(value).

interactions: Use the separate study.tscn desktop viewer: Approach, Inside, Offcuts, Before / cut, Shift cut, Reset.
conical_sightline.qfep_connection: One deterministic cut changes relations between several spaces; permission and historical loss are not computed by it.
conical_sightline.status: Native Godot companion, 17 desktop checks passed; not installed in the museum.

colour_assembly.name: Room to gather
colour_assembly.description: Twelve persistent framed colour panels: canopy, upright screens or an open centre. Arrangement and colour grouping are independently changeable.
colour_assembly.reference_artist: Liam Gillick (original response, not a reconstruction)

parameters.colour_rule: set_colour_rule(0..2): Alternating, Groups of three, One colour

interactions: Use the separate study.tscn desktop gallery to compare arrangement and colour, walk with WASD and mouse, and reset.
colour_assembly.qfep_connection: A deterministic arrangement distributes positions and passages; naming its open centre Gathering cannot establish who gets to occupy or change it.
colour_assembly.status: Native companion; 33 behaviour checks and 13 captures passed. Proposed for Color_Walls; not installed.

colour_wall_studies.name: Wall relations
colour_wall_studies.description: Three original studies after Gillick: 24 coloured rails with adjustable spacing, a crossing with variable depth, and a twelve-segment composition with one reversible omission.

parameters.spacing: set_spacing(0.11..0.21), distance between vertical rail centres in metres
parameters.projection: set_projection(0.18..0.52), local Z for the crossing's vertical members
parameters.omitted: set_omitted(bool), visibility and collision of rail index 5

interactions: Use study.tscn to compare each operation, change colour independently, walk and reset.
colour_wall_studies.qfep_connection: A legible geometric assembly can suggest an organised process without revealing the labour, authority or production it seems to diagram.
colour_wall_studies.status: Independent native companion; 19 behaviour checks and 12 image saves passed. Not installed in a museum hall.
